messages.憤怒を多用する火傷編成で、広域攻撃・火傷付与・味方3名の回復を同時にこなす、憤怒: A Wrath Pierce E.G.O for Wrath-heavy Burn teams that delivers multi-target attacks, Burn infliction, and healing for 3 allies all at once.
messages.広域と火傷: 攻撃加重値は4で、解析Ⅲから(最大共鳴数÷2)ぶん増え最大7になる: **Multi-target and Burn**: Attack Weight is 4, increasing by (highest Resonance ÷ 2) from Threadspin Ⅲ, up to 7. Inflicts 6 Burn on hit (8 at Threadspin Ⅲ).
messages.回復: 攻撃後、現体力の比率が最も低い味方(1+最大共鳴数)名(最大3名)を、最: **Healing**: After the attack, heals (1 + highest Resonance) allies with the lowest current HP ratio, up to 3, by 15% of max HP (18% at Ⅲ, 20% at Ⅳ).
messages.熱せられた鳥籠: メインターゲットに、次のターンの鳥籠を(1+憤怒共鳴数÷3)付: **Searing Birdcage**: Inflicts (1 + Wrath Resonance ÷ 3) Birdcage for the next turn on the main target (up to 2, 3 at Threadspin Ⅲ). It raises the Wrath resistance of Burning enemies, and the bearer also gains Bind at Turn End.
messages.パッシブ「灼熱遊戯」: 火傷回数10以上の敵が死亡すると、全ての敵へ火傷回数を分: **Passive — Blazing Amusement**: When an enemy with 10 or more Burn Count dies, distributes Burn Count among all enemies and restores 8 SP (twice per turn). The condition is demanding.
messages.侵蝕スキル: 2枚とも元から破壊不能コインで、解析Ⅲから火傷・鳥籠が強化され、Ⅳ: **Corrosion skill**: Both Coins are Unbreakable from the start, with Burn and Birdcage strengthened from Threadspin Ⅲ and further at Ⅳ. It cannot distinguish friend from foe and can hit allies, making it hard to handle.
messages.憤怒スキルをまとめて使い、共鳴数で加重値・回復人数・鳥籠を伸ばしてから撃つ。: Use Wrath skills together, raising Attack Weight, healing targets, and Birdcage through Resonance before firing it.
messages.攻撃後3ターン、ターン終了時に精神力が10減る。精神消耗15と合わせて重いので、: For 3 turns after the attack, she loses 10 SP at each Turn End. Together with its 15 Sanity cost, it is heavy, so pick its moments.
messages.必要資源は憤怒7・傲慢3と偏っており、火傷編成で憤怒が余る場面に向く。: It requires 7 Wrath and 3 Pride, a lopsided cost suited to Burn teams with Wrath to spare.
messages.Ⅱ: 「灼熱遊戯」が解放されるが、条件が重く活用しにくい。: **Ⅱ**: Unlocks Blazing Amusement, but its condition is demanding and hard to use.
messages.Ⅲ: 覚醒が強化される(共鳴による加重値、回復18%、火傷8、鳥籠の上限3)。覚: **Ⅲ**: Strengthens Awakening (Resonance-based Attack Weight, 18% healing, 8 Burn, Birdcage cap 3). Enough if you only use Awakening.
messages.Ⅳ: 侵蝕が大きく強化され、覚醒の回復も20%になる。: **Ⅳ**: Greatly strengthens Corrosion, and Awakening's healing becomes 20%.
messages.南部リウ協会4課部長: 火傷を付与するスキルがそろい、憤怒(S2)・傲慢(S1): **[Liu Assoc. South Section 4 Director](persona:0908)**: Has a full set of Burn-inflicting skills and supplies Wrath (S2) and Pride (S1).
messages.蜘蛛の巣親指の親方: 基本スキルの多くが火傷を付与し、憤怒・傲慢の資源も出せる。: **[The House of Spiders: The Thumb Nursefather](persona:0916)**: Many of her basic skills inflict Burn, and she supplies Wrath and Pride resources.
